name: Rama Vision Limited
about: Rama Vision Limited engages in the import, distribution, and marketing of various consumer products in India. It operates in two segments, Trading and Manufacturing. The company offers baby and mother care products; skincare products for babies, children, and mothers; oral and personal care products; and knives, shavers, beauty care accessories, and personal grooming tools. It also provides noodles and ready-to-eat food products; curry pastes, sauces, and cooking ingredients; instant noodles and savoury snack products; cream-filled and cream-sprayed wafer sticks, and flavoured candies; Vietnamese rice-based food products; and rice paper and rice crackers, and canned coconut milk. In addition, the company manufactures wafer-stick products. Further, it provides various services comprising digital marketing, social media management, influencer marketing, branding and strategy, and traditional marketing services; and retail, visual, e-commerce, and promotional merchandising. It sells its products under the PIGEON, MUSTELA, TRISA, KAI, NONGSHIM, REAL THAI, KAB'S JACKPOT, MADDOX, MR. RICE, and ASIAN GRACE brands through distributors, dealers, general trade, modern retail, e-commerce marketplaces, and quick-commerce platforms. The company was incorporated in 1989 and is based in New Delhi, India.
